When provisions ran out, she walked back and forth until Allah guided her to Zamzam water. Many people came to her. Then Allah commanded our master Abraham to build the Kaaba and raise the House's foundations: Ishmael brought stones while Abraham built until they completed it. Then came Allah's command to sacrifice Ishmael: Abraham saw in a dream that he slaughtered his son and told him. He replied, 'Father, do what you are commanded; Allah willing, you will find me patient.' Allah ransomed him with a great sacrifice. Ishmael was a horseman, the first to tame horses, patient and forbearing. He is said to be the first to speak clear Arabic. He kept his promises, commanded his family to pray and give zakat, and called for worshipping Allah and His oneness.
